## Company Overview

Matillion operates in AI, Data & Cloud Infrastructure and is based in Altrincham. Its latest recorded funding round was a Series E Extension round in November 2022.

Matillion is a software company that provides a cloud-native data integration platform to extract, load, and transform data for cloud data warehouses, AI, and analytics.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about Matillion's valuation, stock price, and market status.

Is Matillion a public or private company?

Matillion is a private company.

What is the current stock price of Matillion?

Matillion is a private company, so its shares have no public market price. Caplight tracks Matillion's secondary market activity and provides MarketPrice™ estimates of its share price to Caplight users.

How much is Matillion worth (valuation)?

Matillion's valuation is estimated at $1.5B based on funding round data.

Can I buy Matillion stock?

Matillion shares may be available on secondary markets subject to transfer restrictions. Caplight facilitates secondary market transactions for accredited investors.

When was Matillion's last funding round?

Matillion's most recent funding round was Series E Extension on November 8, 2022.

Who are the main investors in Matillion?

Key investors in Matillion include Sapphire Ventures, Battery Ventures, YFM Equity Partners, Databricks Ventures, General Atlantic.

Will Matillion IPO soon?

No public IPO plans have been announced for Matillion.

How can I track Matillion secondary market activity?

Caplight tracks bids, offers, and trades in Matillion's shares on secondary markets.
